pages.title: We want to create a responsible industry
pages.text: We want to create a responsible industry Home Our products & services Products Customer cases Competence Center News News Our calendar NovaCastTV Social channels Contact us FAQ Support About us Every casting counts About us Our products Global Sales Network Events Contact us Menu » Smarter Casting Starts Here About us At NovaCast, we create innovative solutions that help foundries cast better — predicting defects, enabling resource efficiency and automating processes, to build a smarter, more sustainable industry, where every casting counts. Built in the Foundry, Engineered for Progress. Founded in 1981 in Ronneby, a small industrial town nestled among the beautiful archipelago and pristine nature of southern Sweden, NovaCast grew from a deep respect for both the craft of casting and the environment it thrives in. ​ Our story didn’t start in a lab. From day one, we partnered closely with casting professionals, working together to create solutions that provide more control, better insight, and faster results. ​ ​ What started with thermal analysis has grown into a global offering of simulation and metallurgical control solutions – used in over 50 countries, and still evolving. What began in Ronneby in 1981 remains our headquarters today, with offices in India , the US and Thailand . ​ Real People. Real Knowledge. Real Partnership. Behind every NovaCast solution is a team of engineers, metallurgists, developers, and customer experts – many of whom have worked directly in the foundry industry. This hands-on experience influences everything we do, from product design to customer support. We don’t just understand our users’ challenges – we share them, and we’re dedicated to solving them together. ​ We see ourselves not just as a provider, but as a partner. One that listens, learns, and continuously adapts to support the people who keep this industry moving. We work closely with selected partners around the world. Through this network, we combine global reach with a strong local presence across key markets. If you’re looking for a partner near you, you’ll find more information here . Join us on the journey At NovaCast, every casting counts. Behind every solution is a dedicated team committed to innovation, precision, and responsibility. Together, we empower foundries worldwide to cast smarter, reduce waste, and shape a more sustainable future. pages.text: NovaFlow&Solid showcased at High Pressure Die Casting Seminar in Japan - NovaCast Home Our products & services Products Customer cases Competence Center News News Our calendar NovaCastTV Social channels Contact us FAQ Support About us Every casting counts About us Our products Global Sales Network Events Contact us Menu » NovaFlow&Solid showcased at High Pressure Die Casting Seminar in Japan 2026-07-01 NovaCast Systems recently participated in a High Pressure Die Casting Seminar hosted by our partner, JFS, (Japan Foundry Service) in Japan. The seminar brought together around 35 participants from approximately 20 companies. Our colleague Erik Stivnert delivered an in-depth presentation of NovaFlow&Solid, demonstrating how casting process simulation helps optimize production, improve quality, and reduce defects. We would like to thank JFS for hosting such a well-organized seminar. We look forward to our continued partnership!
